title: zazzle-csharp-indexer MCP tools
description: The tools an MCP client can call with tools/call. Paths are root:relative/path; with one root the prefix may be left out. No tool checks who is calling: the stdio server answers whoever started it, and the daemon socket can only be opened by its owner.

entities.name: overview
entities.description: A compact map of a root: file and line counts by language, top-level directories, entry points and project files, largest files.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server.
entities.result: Five lines per root, computed from the index without reading file contents.
failures: Index still building after the ready timeout: error index_cold ("use find_files").
Unknown root name: error bad_root.

entities.name: outline
entities.description: A file's declarations with line ranges and signatures, or a one-line digest per file for a directory.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server; the file is re-checked through RootIndex.Freshen without Root.Resolve (backlog.json, outline-path-escape).
entities.result: For a file, a header tagged parsed (C#) or heuristic with the digest, then one indented line per declaration; for a directory (path ending in /, or root:), a paged digest list.
failures: No such file: error not_found.
Binary or over 16 MiB: error no_outline.
Several roots and no root prefix: error bad_path.

entities.name: find_symbol
entities.description: Declarations whose name contains (or equals, with exact) the query, case-insensitively, optionally of one kind.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call find_symbol {name, exact?, kind?, root?, limit?, offset?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server.
entities.result: root:path:line kind container.name | signature, exact matches first, then by path; paged, 30 by default.
failures: Missing name: error bad_args.
Index still building: error index_cold ("use search").

entities.name: find_references
entities.description: Lines where an exact identifier occurs, declarations marked D; parsed for C#, word matches elsewhere.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call find_references {name, root?, glob?, limit?, offset?, max_tokens?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server.
entities.result: Per file a header tagged [parsed] or [heuristic], then line: text, after a barrier over the selected files; paged, 60 lines and 4000 tokens by default.
failures: Missing name: error bad_args.
Index still building: error index_cold.

entities.name: search
entities.description: A .NET regex (or literal text) matched per line, prefiltered by the index, in path order.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call search {pattern, literal?, ignore_case?, glob?, root?, mode?, context?, max_results?, offset?, max_tokens?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server.
entities.result: mode lines: each file's label, then line:text with line-text context lines; mode files: matching files; mode count: file:count. A footer gives the count or the next offset. 50 results and 4000 tokens by default.
failures: Missing pattern: error bad_args.
Pattern rejected by .NET and by rg -P or git grep -P: error bad_regex with the dialect notes.
Index still building: answered from a plain scan of the git listing (logged as scan / index_cold, not said in the answer).
Unknown root name: error bad_root.

entities.name: read
entities.description: A line range of a text file with line numbers, under a token budget.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call read {path, start_line?, end_line?, max_tokens?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server; the path must resolve inside the root, symlinks included.
entities.result: n<TAB>text lines and a footer "root:path lines a-b of n"; when truncated, a hint to continue at the next start_line. A repeat of a fully read range whose content is unchanged returns a one-line unchanged note instead.
failures: Missing path: error bad_args.
Path outside the root: error outside_root.
No such file: error not_found.
Binary file: error binary.
Several roots and no root prefix: error bad_path.

entities.name: find_files
entities.description: Files git tracks or would track, filtered by a case-insensitive path substring and a glob.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call find_files {query?, glob?, root?, limit?, offset?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server.
entities.result: root:path per line, paged (100 by default), with a footer.
failures: Unknown root name: error bad_root.
Index still building: answered from git ls-files directly (logged as scan / index_cold).

entities.name: changed_since
entities.description: Files added, modified or deleted since a cursor; without a cursor, a starting cursor.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server.
entities.result: A|M|D root:path lines after a full reconcile of each root, then a new cursor epoch;root=gen;...
failures: Cursor from another engine run: "cursor expired (daemon restarted)" and a new cursor.
Change log no longer reaches back to the cursor: a line saying to re-list with find_files.

entities.name: git_log
entities.description: Recent commits, optionally for one path and filtered by message.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call git_log {path?, root?, n?, grep?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server; the path is not resolved against the root (backlog.json, git-paths-unresolved).
entities.result: hash date author subject per commit, 20 by default.
failures: git exits non-zero: error git_failed with git's message.

entities.name: git_blame
entities.description: Who last changed each line of a range.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server; the path is not resolved against the root (backlog.json, git-paths-unresolved).
entities.result: git blame -w output for the range, 40 lines from start_line by default.
failures: Missing path: error bad_args.
git exits non-zero: error git_failed with git's message.

entities.name: run
entities.description: An allowed read-only program run with an argument list in a root, for questions the other tools cannot answer.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call run {argv: [program, args...], root?, timeout?, max_tokens?}
entities.authorization: RunPolicy.Check: the program's file name must be on the read-only allowlist, with edit and exec options refused for sed, awk, find and rg and only read-only git subcommands; run.unrestricted in config.json or ZAZZLE_INDEXER_RUN_UNRESTRICTED=1 lifts every check, and then the operation can change anything the user can.
entities.result: Standard output under the token budget, then [timed out], [exit n] with standard error, [output truncated] and, for grep, find, cat, head, tail and sed, a hint to use the dedicated tools.
failures: Missing argv: error bad_args.
Refused by the policy: error run_denied with the reason.
Program not found: [exit 127] in the answer.

entities.name: view
entities.description: A terse behavioural view of one C# file, with its source line numbers; zazzle read asks for it through the daemon socket.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server; the path is resolved with Root.Resolve, so it stays inside the root.
entities.result: A header "root:path N lines; terse: <count> <step>, ..." (or "nothing to shorten"), then the view: N for an unchanged line, N~ for a changed one, A-B with a note for collapsed lines (src/View/.dev/contracts.json, view-format). The file is read from disk, not through the index, and the usage log records path view.
failures: Missing path: error bad_args.
Several roots and no root prefix: error bad_path.
A path that leaves the root: error outside_root.
A file not ending in .cs: error not_csharp.
No such file: error not_found.

entities.name: report_gap
entities.description: The agent's one- or two-sentence note on what it could not get, or what was slow, wrong or too verbose.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the server.
entities.result: "recorded"; the note goes into the usage-log record's note field (cut to 500 characters), where zazzle-csharp-indexer report lists it.
failures: Missing what: error bad_args.

relatedViews.relationship: The capability these operations make up.
The behaviour search, read, changed_since and run offer.
The coding agent calls these to answer code questions.
